{{Top|ca}} {{Location |image= |name=Hangar D-13 |created= |destroyed=[[34 ABY]], [[Barabesh system]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[The Escape (episode)|The Escape]]," including the [[Battle of Barabesh|destruction]] of the ''[[Thunderer]]''—and therefore [[Hangar]] D-13—in the [[Barabesh system]], to [[34 ABY]]. |type=[[Hangar]]{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} |location=''[[Thunderer]]'' |terrain= |fauna= |flora= |interest= |affiliation=[[First Order]] }} {{Quote|I'm just preparing my TIE for the training session I'm leading.''"
"''I thought that was in Hangar D-13?''"
"''Operations must have moved it to a different hangar.|Tamara Ryvora and Tierny|audio=HangarD13-TheEscape.flac|}} '''Hangar D-13''' was a [[hangar]] aboard the [[First Order]] [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' In [[34 ABY]], as the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE pilot]] [[Tamara Ryvora]] was preparing her [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighter]] for departure from the [[Star Destroyer]] in order to [[Desertion|desert]] from the First Order, she was questioned by [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] as to what she was doing. In response, Ryvora told Tierny she was readying her [[TIE series|TIE]] for a training session she was to lead. The agent then stated her{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} belief that the training was scheduled to take place in Hangar D-13, to which the [[pilot]] claimed that it must have been moved to a different hangar by [[Security Operations|Operations]]. In response, Tierny instructed the pilot [[Jace Rucklin|DT-798]] to assist Ryvora. Not long thereafter, the Star Destroyer, along with Hangar D-13, was [[Battle of Barabesh|destroyed]] in the [[Barabesh system]] by the [[Team Colossus|residents]] of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. ==Behind the scenes== Hangar D-13 was mentioned in part one of the two-part episode "[[The Escape (episode)|The Escape]]," the finale of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 26]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Docking bays]] [[Category:Thunderer locations]]
